items.question: What are Jade Melbourne's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Jade Melbourne averaged 9.1 points, 2.1 rebounds, and 3.7 assists in 42 games for the Seattle Storm.

items.question: What team does Jade Melbourne play for?
items.answer: Jade Melbourne plays guard for the Seattle Storm. She signed with Seattle for 2026 after two seasons with the Washington Mystics.

items.question: How tall is Jade Melbourne?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Jade Melbourne at 5 feet 10 inches and 145 pounds.

items.question: Did Jade Melbourne play for the Mystics?
items.answer: Yes. Seattle traded Jade Melbourne to the Washington Mystics before the 2024 season for a 2025 third-round pick. She played two seasons in Washington before returning to the Storm in 2026.

items.question: Where is Jade Melbourne from?
items.answer: Jade Melbourne was born in and is from Melbourne, Australia.

items.question: Has Jade Melbourne played in the Olympics?
items.answer: Yes. Jade Melbourne was the Opals' starting point guard at the 2024 Paris Olympics, where Australia won bronze. FIBA named her the 2024 Rising Star of the Paris Olympics.

items.question: Does Jade Melbourne play in the WNBL?
items.answer: Yes. Jade Melbourne has played six WNBL seasons for the UC Capitals. On February 18, 2023 she recorded a triple-double of 19 points, 12 rebounds and 14 assists against Adelaide.

items.question: Did Jade Melbourne play college basketball?
items.answer: No. Jade Melbourne did not play U.S. college basketball. Seattle drafted her out of Australia in the third round, 33rd overall, in 2022, and she made her WNBA debut with the Storm in 2023.
